title: Job Openings at Tribest Corporate Support Limited
content:
Tribest is a corporate support solutions provider with a comprehensive range of people outsourcing services. We have a diversified team of management, strategy, banking and capacity development experts working together to provide organizations with the best human resource management solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Real Estate Marketing Executive

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are seeking an ambitious, results-driven Real Estate Sales Executive to join our team in Abuja.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing prospective buyers, presenting real estate investment opportunities (residential, commercial, and land investments), conducting property viewings, and closing high-value property sales.
	This role requires strong networking abilities, market knowledge of Abuja’s prime real estate corridors, and an unwavering commitment to exceptional client service.


Key Responsibilities


	Direct Sales & Prospecting: Proactively generate qualified leads through networking, cold calling, field prospecting, digital channels, and referral networks across Abuja and surrounding areas.
	Client Engagement & Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with high-net-worth individuals (HNIs), corporate accounts, and private investors.
	Property Inspections & Presentations: Conduct engaging property viewings and site inspections; articulate property value propositions, infrastructure developments, and long-term investment ROI.
	Negotiation & Deal Closure: Lead sales negotiations, structure payment plans, and successfully close property sales while adhering to company pricing guidelines.
	Market Research & Intelligence: Stay up-to-date on Abuja real estate market dynamics, competitive pricing, emerging infrastructure projects, and regulatory changes.
	Sales Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate records of client interactions, leads, pipeline updates, and deals closed using the CRM system.
	Collaboration & Events: Participate in trade shows, property expos, corporate activations, and client networking events to drive brand visibility and lead generation.


Salary
N100,000 monthly.

Application Closing Date: 23rd November, 2026.

2.) Head Teacher

Job Location: Ajah, Lagos

Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Provide strategic and instructional leadership for the school.
	Supervise, mentor, and evaluate teaching staff.
	Ensure effective implementation of the British Curriculum.
	Promote academic excellence and pupil achievement.
	Drive innovation through the integration of educational technology.
	Foster a safe, inclusive, and positive learning environment.
	Maintain strong relationships with parents and other stakeholders.


Requirements


	Female candidate preferred.
	Minimum of 5 years of experience in a school leadership role.
	Bachelor's Degree in Education or a related field (Master's Degree is an advantage).
	Not more than 48 years of age.
	Sound knowledge and practical experience with the British Curriculum.
	Highly proficient in the use of digital technology for teaching, learning, and school administration.
	Strong leadership, communication, organisational, and people management skills.
	Demonstrated ability to improve teaching quality, pupil outcomes, and staff performance.
	TRCN registration and relevant professional certifications are an added advantage.


Application Closing Date: 9th November, 2026.

3.) Hausa Call Centre Representative

Job Location: VI, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Are you fluent in Hausa and English and passionate about customer service?
	We are hiring Hausa-Speaking Call Centre Agents to join our team in Victoria Island (VI), Lagos.


Requirements


	Fluent in Hausa & English
	Excellent communication skills
	Customer-service oriented
	Good computer skills
	Previous call centre / customer service experience is an advantage.


Salary
N200,000 per month. 

Application Closing Date: 30th October, 2026.
